card.name: Second digit inside numbers
card.fires_on: A single digit such as 1, 2 or 3 that is the first digit after a decimal point or section dot, where a second digit follows. It is most common in the upper end of dose ranges and in section cross-references.

modes.label: Dose range upper bound
modes.description: Digit after the decimal point in the second number of a range, like 0.01 to 0.015.
modes.example: maintenance doses of 0.01 to 0.0<<1>>5 mg/kg of vecuronium brom

modes.label: Section reference numbers
modes.description: Digit after the dot in a cross-reference such as 5.10 or 2.13.

card.plain: It fires on a digit in the middle of a multi-digit number, such as the 1 in 0.15 or 5.10.
